question: What is this vidyā composed of and how is it described?
premises: sarvaśāstramayī means composed of all śāstras
sarvasaubhāgyasundarī means beautiful with all fortune
inference: this vidyā is composed of all śāstras and beautiful with all fortune
uncertainties: whether vidyā is subject or apposition is implicit
plain_english: This vidyā is composed of all śāstras and is beautiful with all fortune.
